description.value: The Sooke branch of the Vancouver Island Regional Library has served the community since 1963, sitting on the unceded traditional territory of the T'sou-ke First Nation. It offers a quiet, air-conditioned, scent-free space with meeting rooms available to book, making it a comfortable rest stop for touring cyclists passing through Sooke.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A public library is a practical rest stop for touring cyclists, offering shelter, seating, and free public access. Located in Sooke on a key cycling corridor to the west coast of Vancouver Island.
